job.description:
We are a dynamic and innovative marketing agency that specializes in connecting home service industry businesses with top-tier talent and building kick ass teams. We leverage cutting-edge advertising strategies, technology, and a deep understanding of the digital landscape to help us not only find top talent for companies but retain them. 

Why Join Talent On Tap:

Professional Growth: Opportunity to learn, grow, and advance within the dynamic field of employment solution marketing
Innovative Environment: Collaborate with a team of creative professionals in a supportive and innovative work environment
Client Diversity: Work with a wide range of clients across various service industries, expanding your expertise and portfolio
Remote Location: Work remotely and enjoy a better work-life balance


If you’re ready to unleash your creativity and make a real impact, join us as a graphic designer and bring our clients' visions to life from home. Be part of our growing company and a talented team that celebrates success. If you're passionate about design and eager to grow, apply now and let's build kick ass teams together!

Position Overview
Hours: 30 hours+

Ready to channel your creativity into designs that bring inspiring ideas to life and leave a lasting impression? Join us as a graphic designer, and you'll be at the forefront of crafting captivating social media recruiting campaigns for top clients in the home service industry. Imagine working from your cozy couch, collaborating with a dynamic team of creatives and analytical minds, all while designing eye-catching graphics for social media recruiting campaigns, along with flyers, and postcards for hiring events. With endless opportunities for professional growth, a supportive and celebratory culture, and the chance to introduce innovative design templates, your creativity will know no bounds. 

BONUS: If you have experience creating captivating video content, you may have the opportunity to rise to another level in this position. You would also be crafting scroll-stopping video ads, dynamic reels, and engaging shorts that perfectly capture our clients' passion, culture, and service focus. Step into a role where your artistic flair and strategic thinking will make a real impact—let's create something amazing together!

Benefits
Paid Holidays
Remote Work
Great Team Culture
Professional Development
Growth/Advancement Opportunities

Compensation
$20+ (Depending on Experience)

Position Requirements
Proven experience in creating digital content for social media
Experience creating graphics for ad campaigns
High proficiency in using Canva
Experience with Adobe Illustrator is a plus
Ability to interpret written Ad copy visually
Creative mindset with strong analytical skills and attention to detail
Capability to work normal East Coast business hours
Effective communication skills
Strong ability to meet deadlines
Understanding of Facebook and Instagram graphics and trends
Adaptability to reformulate processes as marketing trends change
Desire to advance and grow professionally
Ability to work well within a KPI structure and create reports
Possession of a computer with proper processing abilities for consistent graphic creation
Collaborative spirit to work alongside a diverse design team
General understanding of social media marketing is a plus
Experience in creating motion graphics is a plus
Experience in creating and editing video ads, reels, and shorts is a plus

Position Responsibilities
Transform clients' visions into visually compelling graphics
Create graphics reflecting clients' passion, job descriptions, company culture, and service focus
Develop social media recruiting campaigns for clients in the home service industry
Design graphics, flyers, and postcards for hiring events
Collaborate with a diverse design team of creatives and analytical thinkers
Introduce new design templates and innovative ways to present information
Participate in training sessions and creative think-tank meetings for professional growth
Contribute to a supportive and celebratory team culture
Provide visual solutions for clients' hiring needs
Ensure effective visual interpretation of written ad copy
Maintain focus on creating reports and working within a KPI structure
Communicate clearly and effectively in weekly/daily meetings
Consistently meet deadlines
Ability to conduct, track, and analyze A/B testing

Company Overview
🎯Culture: We operate with a vibrant and collaborative culture, where innovation and passion drive everything we do. Our team thrives on creativity and teamwork, constantly pushing the envelope to deliver the best solutions for our clients. Every voice is heard here, and we encourage experimentation and new ideas to create something extraordinary. You’ll feel right at home as part of a group that celebrates individuality, encourages growth, and fosters a true sense of belonging​.

🔧Focus Service: Our main focus is helping home service businesses build exceptional teams through innovative recruitment strategies. By blending cutting-edge technology with personalized service, we streamline the hiring process and provide companies with the top talent they need to succeed. As a graphic designer, you will create visuals that bring these strategies to life, crafting campaigns that engage and attract the best in the industry​.

📚Learning Opportunities: We’re passionate about professional growth and provide continuous learning opportunities for our team. Whether it’s mastering the latest design trends or developing new creative techniques, you’ll have the chance to expand your skill set and grow within the company. Plus, the diverse nature of our clients means you’ll be exposed to a variety of industries, offering valuable experience that will challenge and inspire you​.

🤝Standards: We hold ourselves to the highest standards of creativity and professionalism. Our commitment to excellence means that every project we deliver is polished, effective, and tailored to our clients' unique needs. As a designer, you’ll work closely with a dedicated team that values quality and innovation, ensuring that your designs not only meet but exceed expectations​.

Working Conditions
▶️Premium Workplace: Work from the comfort of your home while being part of a dynamic, supportive team. We pride ourselves on creating a premium workplace experience, where flexibility meets collaboration. You’ll have access to top-tier resources, a fantastic team environment, and the autonomy to bring your best ideas to life. Here, work-life balance and career satisfaction are priorities, making this a truly exceptional place to advance your career​.
